title: QUIC RFC 9000 CRYPTO Retransmission Acknowledgment Boundary Work Item
summary: Close the focused S13.3 CRYPTO retransmission proof tail by proving the queued-repair acknowledgment boundary and nonzero CRYPTO offset preservation.
planned_changes:
- Add negative requirement-home proof that a queued Handshake CRYPTO repair is removed when the original packet is acknowledged before the retransmission flush.
- Add edge proof that retransmitted Handshake CRYPTO data preserves a nonzero CRYPTO stream offset after contiguous egress data advances the stream.
- Add canonical x_test_refs and focused architecture/work-item/verification artifacts for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0789.
- Regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, run focused and full Release verification, and keep endpoint interop claims out of scope.
verification_plan: Run the focused S13P3-0006 requirement-home filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate canonical SpecTrace JSON with the core profile, run the Release build, run the full Release no-build test suite, and check the diff.
out_of_scope: General QUIC recovery algorithm completeness beyond the traced local CRYPTO repair boundary.
New congestion-control, loss-detection, or PTO heuristics.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused proof and trace topoff over the existing Handshake CRYPTO retransmission recovery seam.
